snippet.description:
The Real Mains Preparation Happens Before Prelims.

The gap between UPSC Prelims and Mains is getting shorter, leaving aspirants with limited time to build their Mains preparation from scratch.

In this short, we discuss why serious UPSC Mains preparation should happen before Prelims. By analysing Previous Year Questions (PYQs), understanding how Current Affairs can be integrated with the Mains syllabus, identifying probable areas and building value addition, aspirants can use the post-Prelims period for revision, refinement and improving their answers rather than starting their preparation all over again.

The goal is simple: build your Mains preparation in advance and use the Prelims–Mains gap to create an edge — even if it means gaining half a mark more in every answer.

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2027, this is the phase to take your Mains preparation seriously.

Prepare before Prelims. Revise after Prelims.
